name: How do I communicate with the project manager during my remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I communicate with the project manager during my remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Communication is a cornerstone of our project management approach at Frasheski Construction. You will have a dedicated project manager who serves as your primary point of contact. We establish regular communication channels, which can include weekly meetings, phone calls, emails, or a project management software portal, based on your preference. We ensure you are always informed about progress, milestones, and any decisions that need your input.
acceptedAnswer.description: You'll have a dedicated project manager and we establish regular communication channels based on your preference.
